svg.aria-label: How the world model is trained: flow matching on the stored PhysX trajectory
svg.text: the red ball's 15 channels over 60 frames
tau is drawn at random every step; here 0.5
x1 - x0 is the true direction from the noise sample to the truth;
w = 1 if the object moves in the truth, 0.1 if it stays still
Prediction: start from a fresh noise sample and
Variant A, the control: the same network, no noise,
one pass, squared error on x1.
Two small extra terms keep positions consistent
with velocities and predict first contacts.
channels: dx dy dz = how far it moved; r1..r6 = orientation;
vx vy vz = velocity; wx wy wz = spin.
red = positive, blue = negative, after the design's normalisation.
